**Finding: Compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

The only non-compete/exclusivity covenant in the Agreement is Section 5.8 (p0367–p0369), and it binds Harpoon and its Affiliates, not AbbVie. Supporting confirmation:

- **§5.6.1 (p0363):** Harpoon's retained right to exploit other products is expressly "subject to Section 5.8."
- **§7 (p0429):** refers to "in the case of Harpoon, its exclusivity obligations hereunder" — confirming the obligation is one-directional.
- **§5.8.2 (p0369):** the Acquisition / Change-in-Control–plus-Segregation carve-outs relieve *Harpoon*, and even give AbbVie an added election to cut off Confidential Information flow — additional Customer protection.

Targeted searches for covenants running against our side ("AbbVie shall not", "compete", field-of-use, "shall not develop or commercialize", "during the Term, AbbVie") surfaced nothing restrictive: the hits are efforts standards, records inspection, royalty reductions, and settlement limits. The "in the Field in the Territory" wording in §5.1.3 is a limit on the scope of the licence granted *to us*, not a covenant restricting AbbVie's own business, and is not a field-of-use restriction within this rule.

Because the restriction benefits our party, it must not be flagged, and the preferred element — Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction — is already met on the face of the document.
